PCSB00331.name: Kung Fu Rabbit
PCSB00331.desc: Life in the temple of rabbits hangs by a thread. Universal evil has struck again and kidnapped all of your disciples. Only you managed to escape. They let you live... and they'll soon regret it! Use your agility and combat skills to save your disciples! Jump from roof to roof, slide gracefully along walls, sneak up on your enemies and then rip them to shreds! Detailed graphics, humour, hours of gameplay and intuitive controls. Each level requires logic, precision, agility and lots of sabre rattling. The game also has plenty of trophies to win, babies to save, carrots to eat and a universal evil to expunge!

PCSB00694.desc: La-Mulana is an Action Archaeological Ruins Exploration game. Your destination is La-Mulana itself, the legendary place that is said to be the origin of all culture and life. Set in these huge mystical ruins, you must solve many mysteries, battle enemies and find the secret treasure of life that remains in its vast tunnels. As the hero, Dr. Lemeza Kosugi, solve these great mysteries hidden inside the enormous ruins and fight any monster standing in your way. You must go to deep within the ruins! Of course, getting there won't be easy. The further you go in, the more difficult the traps that await you. The so-called Guardian is waiting...

A scan of the neighboring planets revealed a number of energy signatures, which may provide the special material needed to replace the damaged warp core and get back to cruising through the cosmos. However, what began as a routine away-mission to fix his engine quickly spirals into a dangerous game of search, shoot, and survive. Blast your way through alien landscapes, seek out valuable secrets, and defeat ancient guardians to unlock powers from a legendary supreme culture in this exciting journey of mystery and adventure.

NPUB31234_29.name: Dynasty Warriors 8 - Weapon System Pack 1
NPUB31234_29.desc: The weapon type ''Flame Blade'' will allow you to run into the enemy ranks and unleash a series of powerful Strong Attacks, shrouded in flames. This weapon type can be acquired by selecting the stage ''Secret Weapon Acquisition Battle - Flame Blade'', which will be added to Free Mode. The weapon type ''Revolving Crossbow'' will allow you to attack from both close-range and from distance. By rotating the left stick in 1st Strong Attack, a powerful rapid-fire attack will be unleashed. This weapon type can be acquired by selecting the stage ''Secret Weapon Acquisition Battle - Revolving Crossbow'', which will be added to Free Mode.
NPUB31234_29.author: fu

NPUB31234_30.name: Dynasty Warriors 8 - Weapon System Pack 2
NPUB31234_30.desc: Foot Plates' will allow you to attack using a series of kicks. By continually landing these kicks, a wide variety of aerial attacks will also be available. 'Emei Piercers' will allow you to unleash swift attacks that strike enemies in a wide range. Alternatively, you can grab your enemies and attack them with thrusts and stabs. Further, a more powerful weapon of these types can be acquired by selecting the stage 'Sabatons Acquisition Battle' or 'Emei Piercers Acquisition Battle',, which will be added to Free Mode. A weapon of these type can be acquired in battle, or by visiting the Blacksmith and selecting 'Obtain DLC' within Ambition Mode.
NPUB31234_30.author: fu

NPUB31234_31.name: Dynasty Warriors 8 - Weapon System Pack 3
NPUB31234_31.desc: The Bladebow allows you to ready an arrow with 1st Strong Attack , then fire it with a subsequent Strong Attack. Well-timed button presses as you fire your arrows will power up your attacks still further.The Paired Fans are weapons which are particularly suited to aerial attacks, allowing up to three airborne attacks at a time. Further, a more powerful weapon of these types can be acquired by selecting the stage 'Bladebow Acquisition Battle' or 'Paired Fans Acquisition Battle', which will be added to Free Mode. A weapon of these types can be acquired in battle, or by visiting the Blacksmith and selecting 'Obtain DLC' within Ambition Mode.

BLUS30522_3.name: Mortal Kombat - Freddy Kruger
BLUS30522_3.desc: Download and play as the Mortal Kombat Warrior Freddy Krueger. A malevolent spirit of the Dream Realm, Freddy Krueger preys on the souls of the living as they sleep. When Shao Kahn began to steal Earthrealm's souls - souls Freddy considered his own - Freddy battled the emperor in the Dream Realm. But Shao Kahn's will was too strong. He pulled Freddy into the real world, where he was mortal, and defeated him. A badly injured yet determined Freddy fitted both his hands with demonically enhanced razor gloves. Once he has killed Shao Kahn he will find a way back to the Dream Realm, where he will torment Earthrealm's souls for eternity. Visit www.themortalkombat.com for details.

BLUS30522_5.name: Mortal Kombat - Kenshi
BLUS30522_5.desc: Download and play as the Warrior Kenshi. For years the swordsman Kenshi traveled the world in search of worthy opponents. When a mysterious elderly man named Song offered to show him the location of Sento, an ancient sword worthy of his abilities, Kenshi succumbed to pride. He followed Song to a tomb wherein lay the Well of Souls. When Kenshi retrieved the sword, spirits of ancient warriors spewed forth, blinding him. Song then revealed himself to be Shang Tsung. He consumed the souls, leaving Kenshi in the dark labyrinth to die. But Sento called to Kenshi. It led him out of the tomb and revealed his lost heritage as a descendant of the warriors who had been buried there. Kenshi vowed to slay Shang Tsung and free the souls of his ancestors. Visit www.themortalkombat.com for more details.

BLUS30522_9.name: Mortal Kombat - Rain
BLUS30522_9.desc: Download and play as the Mortal Kombat Warrior Rain. A refugee orphaned by Shao Kahn's conquest, Rain grew up under the protection of the Edenian Resistance. An exceptional fighter, he soon rose through their ranks. As his reputation grew, so did his arrogance. When Rain demanded leadership of the Resistance forces, he was refused. Infuriated, he turned against his rebel comrades and betrayed them to their sworn enemy. In payment for this treason, Rain was promised his own army by the emperor Shao Kahn. Power would be his - no matter the cost. Visit www.themortalkombat.com for details.

BLUS30522_12.name: Mortal Kombat - Skarlet
BLUS30522_12.desc: Download and play as the Warrior Skarlet. Shao Kahn has many warriors under his command, but his trust lies solely in the fighters of his own creation. An expert tracker, Skarlet preys on those deemed enemies of the empire. During kombat, Skarlet gains strength from her opponent's blood, absorbing it through her skin.

BLUS30585_0.name: Red Faction Armageddon - Path to War
BLUS30585_0.desc: The Earth Defense Force has been defeated and Mars is finally free. However, Adam Hale is back and seeking revenge against the Red Faction. His target is the Terraformer. Relive the battle for the Terraformer through four new missions featuring flyers, orbital strikes, and the Red Faction tank. Unlock two new weapons, the Sharpshooter and the Shard Cannon while earning ten new trophies in this new mission pack for Red Faction: Armageddon!

BLUS30585_2.name: Red Faction Armageddon - Ruin Pack
BLUS30585_2.desc: Red Faction: Armageddon's Ruin Mode is all about one thing: destruction. In 'Free Play' you'll wreak havoc on a variety of maps with unlimited time and ammo. 'Challenge' is a race against the clock to do as much damage as possible. Break the high score to unlock new maps. Afterwards, flaunt your catastrophic conquests on the Leaderboards by comparing your ranking with friends or players worldwide!

BLUS30258.name: Red Faction Guerilla - Demons Of The Badlands
BLUS30258.desc: Break free and experience the all new single player game in this prequel chapter of the Red Faction universe. Mariner Valley, the once peaceful home of the Marauder people, has been torched and defiled by the EDF. The Marauders demand vengeance and Samanya leads the revolt. Set several years before the arrival of Alec Mason on Mars, take control of Samanya to explore the Mariner Valley outside of Tharsis. Exact your revenge with 7 all new weapons including the Spiker machine gun and Marauder Missilepod, and 3 new vehicles including the Punisher walker. Perfect your guerrilla tactics with 10 new actions including raids and demolitions. Show off your skills with 10 new unlockable trophies. Take control and lead the Marauder revolution.

BLUS30258_0.name: Red Faction Guerilla - Multiplayer Pack
BLUS30258_0.desc: Download the Red Faction: Guerrilla Multiplayer Pack and dismantle the opposition in two new multiplayer modes and eight new maps. In Bagman, players score points by securing the 'bag' and taking out their opponents. Increase the carnage in Team Bagman, where the same rules apply, but players are forcedto utilize teamwork and guerrilla tactics to eliminate the opposition. Experience a constant sense of vertigo in the new map Puncture, or smash your way through Remnant where the density of destruction is higher than any other multiplayer level.

BLUS30258_1.name: Red Faction Guerilla - Smasher Pack
BLUS30258_1.desc: Strategic destruction takes center stage in this Red Faction: Guerrilla Smasher Pack that adds a new Wrecking Crew mode along with eight new Wrecking Crew maps. This new mode focuses on using walker vehicles to inflict as much destruction as possible before handing off the controller to the next player. Jump behind the controls of an armored Walker and demolish large towers and structures in the new map Repercussion, then sit back and witness the devastating glory as the enemy stronghold crumbles in cascading destruction.

NPUA80136.name: Siren - Blood Curse Episode 10
NPUA80136.desc: An American TV crew has arrived in Japan to film an expose on the legend of the 'vanished village'. Controlling seven different playable characters, the player must uncover the mystery behind the curse that grips the eerie village of Hanuda. The unique 'sight jack' system allows the player to see from the point of view of the Shibito, or living dead, to avoid their detection or watch as they close in on the player and companions. Intense graphics, realistic character animation, and a gritty film-like graphical presentation add to the horror of Siren: Blood Curse.

BLUS30196.name: Valkyria Chronicles - Challenge of the Edy Detachment
BLUS30196.desc: Experience an enthralling new chapter in the critically acclaimed tactical RPG, Valkyria Chronicles, with an exciting expansion pack! Join the members of the Edy Detachment as they venture through 6 new maps of unique skirmish battles, each designed to feature a different soldier class, the scout, lancer, sniper, engineer, shocktrooper and the tank. Use of this expansion pack requires a copy of the original Valkyria Chronicles game as well as the latest patch.

BLUS30196_0.name: Valkyria Chronicles - Edy's Mission Enter the Edy Detachment
BLUS30196_0.desc: Experience an enthralling new chapter in the critically acclaimed tactical RPG, VALKYRIA CHRONICLES, with an exciting expansion pack! Six members of the Gallian Army have been separated from Squad 7 and on their journey to reunite with their squad, stumble upon a tiny village under attack by the Imperial Army. Playas Edy and command your team to defend the small village from annihilation! Use of this expansion pack requires a copy of the original VALKYRIA CHRONICLES game as well as the latest patch.

BLUS30196_1.name: Valkyria Chronicles - Hard EX Mode
BLUS30196_1.desc: Re-discover the excitement of the critically acclaimed tactical RPG, VALKYRIA CHRONICLES, now available in EXTRA HARD Mode for expert level skirmishes. Stronger and larger enemy units, new bonus weapons, and dynamic melee combat. Challenge your troops for the ultimate battle! Use of this expansion pack requires a copy of the original VALKYRIACHRONICLES game as well as the latest patch.

BLUS30196_2.name: Valkyria Chronicles - Selverias Mission Behind Her Blue Flame
BLUS30196_2.desc: Unveil an engaging new chapter in the critically acclaimed tactical RPG, VALKYRIA CHRONICLES, with an exciting expansion pack! Taking place several years before the original storyline, you play as Johann, a young engineer assigned to Selverias troop in the Imperial Army. Engage in a variety of missions battling the Gallian Army, and experience war from the eyes of the enemy! Use of this expansion pack requires a copy of the original VALKYRIA CHRONICLES game as well as the latest patch.

BLES01275_2.name: Battlefield 3 - Back 2 Karkand Map Pack
BLES01275_2.desc: Back to Karkand is a massive themed expansion pack. It features four of the most loved Battlefield maps ever, boldly reimagined with the power of the Frostbite 2 engine. It also gives you new weapons, vehicles, dog tags, and persistence in the form of all-new 'assignments' to carry out on the battlefield.

BLES01275_5.name: Battlefield 3 - Close Quarters Map Pack
BLES01275_5.desc: Battlefield 3: Close Quarters is a themed expansion pack bringing the team play of Battlefield 3 indoors. The frantic infantry combat is amplified by added persistence and new weapons, while HD Destruction lets players reduce entire locales to ruin.

BLES01275_6.name: Battlefield  3 - Co-op Weapons Shortcut
BLES01275_6.desc: Extend your arsenal with this set of bonus weapons that normally requires you to complete the co-op campaign in order to unlock them.

BLES01275_7.name: Battlefield 3 - End Game
BLES01275_7.desc: Battlefield 3: End Game delivers some of the most high-speed warfare to date across four vast maps. Race through enemy lines using the new dirt bike, or fight back aerial assaults with new lightweight AA vehicles. Coordinate lightning fast attacks and defenses in the return of the classic Capture The Flag game mode.

BLES01275_8.name: Battlefield  3 - Onlinepass
BLES01275_8.desc: Buy the Online Pass to access all online portions of Battlefield 3.

BLES01275_12.name: Battlefield  3 - Premium
BLES01275_12.desc: Take your Battlefield 3 multiplayer experience to the next level with Battlefield 3 Premium! Containing a staggering amount of content, Battlefield 3 Premium offers all expansion packs with early access, new soldier and weapon camos, and a number of exclusive in-game items all for a one-time fee.

BLES01275_14.name: Battlefield  3 - Recon Kit Shortcut
BLES01275_14.desc: Instantly unleash the full potential of the Recon Kit! This Shortcut unlocks all weapons and gadgets unique to the Recon Kit.

BLES01275_15.name: Battlefield  3 - The Ultimate Shortcut Bundle
BLES01275_15.desc: *Warning, invalid RAP*\nGet all weapons and gadgets unique to all four classes, all upgrades for both air and ground vehicles, and all co-op weapons in the ultimate shortcut bundle! This massive pack immediately unlocks all 122 weapons, gadgets, and vehicle upgrades from all other available shortcut packs.

BLES01832_2.name: Battlefield 4 - Dragons Teeth
BLES01832_2.desc: Battlefield 4™ Dragon’s Teeth drops you into urban combat across Asian cities in four all-new multiplayer maps. Wreak havoc in a floating restaurant or drain the lake opening up for a frontal tank assault, all while the battle rages between the modern high rises of Sunken Dragon. Fight among the huge monuments of despots in the grey concrete Propaganda. Wage wars within the bustling alleyways and upon the rooftops of Pearl Market. Cruise with fast-moving PWC’s on the canals in the pristine park to get the upper hand in the rapid-paced infantry battle of Lumphini Garden. Dragon’s Teeth also includes five new weapons, the controllable unmanned ground vehicle R.A.W.R., ten assignments and the new game mode Chain Link, where you create chains by linking together capture points to win the battle.

BLES01403_0.name: Hitman Absolution - Agency Jagd P22G
BLES01403_0.desc: The Agency Jagd P22G is a modern top-tier pistol. This weapon is also included in the Agency Gun Pack DLC.
BLES01403_0.author: kado-san

BLES01403_1.name: Hitman Absolution - Agency SPS 12
BLES01403_1.desc: The Agency SPS 12 is a brutal semi-automatic shotgun. This weapon is also included in the Agency Gun Pack DLC.
BLES01403_1.author: kado-san

BLES01403_2.name: Hitman Absolution - Bartoli Custom Gun
BLES01403_2.desc: The Bartoli Custom Pistol is an engineered precision weapon complete with sight and silencer. This weapon is also available as part of the High Tech Pack, which is included in the Suit and Gun Collection.
BLES01403_2.author: kado-san

BLES01403_3.name: Hitman Absolution - Bronson M1928 Submachine Gun
BLES01403_3.desc: The Bronson M1928 is a classic submachine gun with high fire rate and deadly stopping power. This gun is also included in the Public Enemy Pack, which is included in the Suit and Gun Collection.
BLES01403_3.author: kado-san

BLES01403_5.name: Hitman Absolution Deus Ex Verkleidung
BLES01403_5.desc: Dress Agent 47 in the iconic combat armor used by Adam Jensen in Deus Ex: Human Revolution and get better protection from firearms with advanced armor.

BLES01403_6.name: Hitman Absolution Deus Ex Zenith
BLES01403_6.desc: The Zenith pistol was the handgun of choice for Adam Jensen in Deus Ex: Human Revolution and can now be used by Agent 47 in Hitman Absolution. The 10mm compact pistol can be equipped with a Stenier-Bisley silencer to make sure that Agent 47's missions can be completed like a Silent Assassin.

BLES01403_7.name: Hitman Absolution - High Roller Disguise
BLES01403_7.desc: The High Roller suit dresses Agent 47 in a fancy tuxedo. The High Roller suit is also included in the High Roller Pack, which is also available in the Suit and Gun Collection.
BLES01403_7.author: kado-san

BLES01403_9.name: Hitman Absolution - High Tech Disguise
BLES01403_9.desc: The High Tech suit prepares Agent 47 for action with 50% increased armor. The High Tech suit is also available as part of the High Tech Pack, which is included in the Suit and Gun Collection.
BLES01403_9.author: kado-san

BLES01403_11.name: Hitman Absolution - Krugermeier 2-2 Gun
BLES01403_11.desc: The Krugermeier 2-2 pistol is an accurate, reliable stealth weapon with a built-in silencer. The Krugermeier 2-2 Gun is also available as part of the High Roller Pack, which is also included in the Suit and Gun Collection.
BLES01403_11.author: kado-san

BLES01403_12.name: Hitman Absolution - Public Enemy Disguise
BLES01403_12.desc: The Public Enemy Disguise allows the Original Assassin to dress in a stylish Public Enemy gangster suit. This disguise is also available as part of the Public Enemy Pack, which is also included in the Suit and Gun Collection.
BLES01403_12.author: kado-san

NPEA00145_5.name: Hustle Kings - Time Savers Pack

BLES00933.name: LA Noire - A Slip Of The Tongue Traffic Case
BLES00933.desc: When a suspect caught behind the wheel of a stolen car claims to have bought the vehicle fair and square, Detectives Phelps and Bekowsky are unimpressed. When he produces a pink slip and bill of sale as proof, they sit up and take notice. There follows an investigation that will throw up bumbling car thieves, double talking auto dealers, and a theft racket that stretches across Los Angeles and the state line.
BLES00933.author: W00fer, mrssl

BLES00933_0.name: LA Noire - Nicholson Electroplating Arson Case
BLES00933_0.desc: At 9:45 in the morning, a thunderous explosion rocks Los Angeles. City blocks are flattened and smoke and ash fill the air. Detectives Phelps and Biggs race to the site of the former Nicholson Electroplating plant to find a pile of unanswered questions. What caused the explosion? What were Nicholson's employees working on? And where are chief chemist Dr Harold McLellan and his mysterious female assistant?
BLES00933_0.author: W00fer, mrssl

BLES00933_1.name: LA Noire - Reefer Madness Vice Case
BLES00933_1.desc: Vice Narcotics receives a tip from one Freddie Calhoun, junkie, snitch and all around no-hoper. Freddie seems to be playing it straight for once, sharing information on a city-wide marijuana distribution ring. Detective Phelps and Earle will search, question and raid their way to the top of the operation, and in the process learn how the crooks could be smuggling fifty pound shipments of dope in plain sight.
BLES00933_1.author: mrssl

BLES00933_3.name: LA Noire - The Broderick Detective Suit
BLES00933_3.desc: The Broderick unlockable suit boosts Cole Phelps' fist-fighting abilities and resilience to damage. Throughout L.A. Noire, Phelps will inevitably encounter suspects or persons of interest who prove resistant to arrest. Phelps' hand-to-hand fighting skills could be called into action in these cases and the Broderick suit, which enhances his fighting abilities, will help give Cole the edge in making that collar.
BLES00933_3.author: mrssl

BLES00933_4.name: LA Noire - The Button Man Detective Suit and Badge Pursuit Challenge
BLES00933_4.desc: Hidden around L.A. Noire's beautiful recreation of 1947 Los Angeles are 20 police badges to find and collect. Find all 20 of these badges to unlock the dapper Button Man Detective suit which provides extra ammo for all weapons. Each badge also provides 5 additional XP which will help further unlock Intuition Points - special credits that can be used to give Phelps a key investigative insight when he needs it most.
BLES00933_4.author: mrssl

BLES00933_5.name: LA Noire - The Chicago Piano Weapon
BLES00933_5.desc: The Chicago Piano, used by both law enforcement officers and criminals, was favored for its reliability, ergonomics, compact size, large 45-round cartridge, and high rate of automatic fire. This bonus weapon will be stored in the trunk of Detective Cole Phelps' car throughout L.A. Noire, ensuring that extra firepower is always close at hand.
BLES00933_5.author: mrssl

BLES00933_6.name: LA Noire - The Consuls Car Traffic Case
BLES00933_6.desc: In a dusty backlot, a gleaming new model Packard sits abandoned. Without an owner, without license plates, without even a full complement of wheels, the car could be headed for the scrapyard and the case for a dead end. But detectives do have one lead the vehicle is registered to the Argentinean Consulate of Los Angeles. And there is the matter of a curious diary recovered from the scene...
BLES00933_6.author: mrssl

BLES00933_8.name: LA Noire - The Naked City Vice Case
BLES00933_8.desc: Julia Randall, a stunning young fashion model with the world at her feet, is found dead, floating in her own bathtub. To the Homicide Squad it looks like a textbook society suicide a glamorous life come to a nasty end but coroner Malcolm Carruthers remains unconvinced. It falls to Detectives Phelps and Earle to work the scene, and determine which of Miss Randall's many vices finally killed her.
BLES00933_8.author: mrssl

BLES00933_9.name: LA Noire - The Sharpshooter Detective Suit
BLES00933_9.desc: The Sharpshooter unlockable suit enhances your aim with rifles and pistols. Always a worst case scenario for any Detective working a case, there are inevitably occasions when pursuing or confronting a suspect escalates to gunfire. In these shootout situations, the Sharpshooter suit gives Cole extra aiming precision to take criminals down.
BLES00933_9.author: mrssl

BLES01132_2.name: Mortal Kombat - Freddy Krueger Character
BLES01132_2.desc: *Warning, invalid RAP*\nDownload and play as Freddy Krueger. When Shao Kahn began to steal Earthrealm's souls Freddy battled the emperor in the Dream Realm. Shao Kahn pulled Freddy into the real world and defeated him. A badly injured yet determined Freddy fitted both his hands with demonically enhanced razor gloves. Once he has killed Shao Kahn he will return to the Dream Realm to torment Earthrealm's souls for eternity.

BLES01132_3.name: Mortal Kombat - Kenshi Character
BLES01132_3.desc: *Warning, invalid RAP*\nDownload and play as the Warrior Kenshi. For years the swordsman Kenshi traveled the world in search of worthy opponents. When a mysterious man offered to show him the location of Sento, an ancient sword worthy of his abilities, Kenshi succumbed to pride. When Kenshi retrieved the sword, spirits of ancient warriors spewed forth, blinding him. The man revealed himself to be Shang Tsung and Kenshi vowed revenge.

BLES01132_12.name: Mortal Kombat - Rain Character
BLES01132_12.desc: *Warning, invalid RAP*\nDownload and play as the Warrior Rain. A refugee orphaned by Shao Kahn's conquest, Rain grew up under the protection of the Edenian Resistance. An exceptional fighter, he rose through their ranks. As his reputation grew, so did his arrogance. When Rain demanded leadership of the Resistance forces, he was refused. Infuriated, he turned against his rebel comrades. In payment for this treason, Rain was promised his own army by the emperor Shao Kahn.

BLES01132_13.name: Mortal Kombat - Skarlet Character
BLES01132_13.desc: *Warning, invalid RAP*\nDownload and play as the Mortal Kombat Warrior Skarlet. Shao Kahn has many warriors under his command, but his trust lies solely in the fighters of his own creation. Warrior blood gathered from countless battlefields, fused with sorcery, produced his most effective enforcer yet. An expert tracker, Skarlet preys on those deemed enemies of the empire. During kombat, Skarlet gains strength from her opponent's blood, absorbing it through her skin. Shao Kahn has a new mission for this formidable Kombatant: discover Quan Chi's true intentions and kill him if he plots betrayal of the emperor.

BLES00949_4.name: Need for Speed - Hot Pursuit - Racer Timesaver Pack
BLES00949_4.desc: Unlock all 48 cars immediately.\nThis is the perfect pack for Racers who want to get their hands on the hottest cars in Seacrest, but don't quite have the time to win them all. Featuring cars that are available only to Racers such as the Pagani Zonda Cinque Roadster and the Porsche 918 Spyder. Purchasing this pack will immediately unlock access to all 48 cars available in your Racer career. You'll be able to use them in events where they are eligible both online and solo. However, you will still need to win events to progress through Racer levels - think you've got what it takes to handle these beauties? Prove it.

Maserati Quattroporte Sport GT S, Aston Martin DBS, Audi R8 5.2 FSI, Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren 722 Edition, Lamborghini Revent'n, Bugatti Veyron 16.4 and the Chevrolet Corvette Z06. BLES00949_6.name: Need for Speed - Hot Pursuit - SCPD Timesaver Pack
BLES00949_6.desc: Carbon Motors E7 and the Porsche Panamera Turbo and all 48 cars in SCPD mode.\n\nThis is the ideal purchase for SCPD recruits who want all the hottest cars in the SCPD arsenal but don't quite have the time to win them all. The SCPD have access to some cars that are not available to Racers such as the Carbon Motors E7 and the Porsche Panamera Turbo. Purchasing this pack will immediately unlock access to all 48 available cars for your Cop career. You'll be able to use them in events where they are available both online and in solo play. Posing as amateur vigilantes or villains, gamers create their own Bats and The Jokerz characters using unprecedented customization options including insane costumes, homebrewed gadgets and a wide range of traditional and imagined weapons.

NPEB01141.name: Guacamelee
NPEB01141.desc: Press CIRCLE in reActPSN to unlock the full game.\nJuan Aguacate, an agave farmer who stumbles upon a Legendary Luchador mask, must find the strength and courage to become the Hero he's always dreamed of being and put a stop to this. Not for you, not for Calaca, but for El Presidente's Daughter, the most beautiful girl in the entire world.
NPEB01141.author: kado-san

NPEB01085.name: Guardians of Middle Earth
NPEB01085.desc: Guardians of Middle-earth delivers an authentic multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game set in Middle-earth and crafted specifically for console systems. Gamers team up as the most powerful heroes and villains from the greatest fantasy epic of all time, bringing up to 10 players together in strategic five versus five competitive multiplayer battle arenas in the epic setting of Middle-earth.

NPEB00332.name: Hard Corps Uprising
NPEB00332.desc: Press CIRCLE in reActPSN to unlock the full game.\nThrilling retro run-and-gun action is back with a vengeance in Hard Corps: Uprising, a new 2D side scroller developed by ARC System Works that pays homage to classic Konami action series. Play as the soldier Bahamut as he begins to write his legend. Battle in the grueling trenches of Arcade mode or the all-new RISING mode, where a life bar and point system allow you to purchase items and upgrades to build your soldier up and achieve ultimate victory. Need help? Partner with a friend to lay down some serious carnage.

NPEB00395.name: Hoard
NPEB00395.desc: Press CIRCLE in reActPSN to unlock the full game.\nHOARD is an innovative fast-paced arcade action-strategy title from Big Sandwich Games that puts you in control of conquering a medieval kingdom. Your goal is to build a giant pile of gold for your lair.

NPEB01387.name: How to survive
NPEB01387.desc: Press CIRCLE in reActPSN to unlock the full game.\nYou are shipwrecked on an isolated island, a desperate castaway in a total freak show world. How will you survive?
NPEB01387.author: zigotundra

NPEB00476.name: I AM ALIVE
NPEB00476.desc: Unlock with reactPSN 2.10 or higher by pressing circle button.\n'I Am Alive' starts twelve months after the apocalypse has wiped out most of the Earth's population. Buildings have been destroyed and, more importantly, looted. Supplies are few and far between and major sections of the city in which you find yourself have been overrun with enough dust that breathing just isn't possible. Pockets of machete- or gun-wielding hooligans litter the urban landscape, making travel even more difficult. And when you're not choosing between fleeing or fighting an enemy, you're struck by an encounter with an innocent victim clinging to life. Will you give up your painkillers to save a stranger, even with the virtual certainty that you'll need them before your quest is done? With no zombies, no aliens, and no magic powers, 'I Am Alive' focuses on the one element inherent in its title -- your humanity.

NPEB00410.name: RISK Factions
NPEB00410.desc: Unlock with reactPSN 2.10 or higher by pressing circle button.\nRisk: Factions offers innovative ways of experiencing the timeless turn-based board game in both objective-based and world conquest modes. Players will be able to engage as one of five playable factions, each with different strengths, as they wage war on new maps with dynamic terrain in their quest for missile silos in order to strategically dominate the game. Additionally, as rivals go head-to-head during unique, animated combat missions, enemies will be able to trigger 'Overkill' moments, based on the roll of the dice, and unlock avatar awards while attempting global supremacy. With a special animated art style, kooky humor and a choice of five oddball factions, Risk: Factions is designed to challenge and captivate both new and seasoned Risk fans on their quest for world domination.

NPEB01374.name: Sanctum 2
NPEB01374.desc: Press CIRCLE in reActPSN to unlock the full game.\nSanctum 2 is the sequel to the world's first Tower Defense/FPS hybrid game. Pick from four unique character classes and embark on a mission to protect the oxygen-producing Cores from hordes of deadly aliens who are threatened by their existence. In Sanctum 2, you will utilize elements from multiple gameplay genres to succeed. Construct towers and walls during the building phase before the enemies attack, then jump into the fray and blast everything to pieces in FPS mode. You can progress through the single-player campaign yourself, or play with up to four friends in co-op to discover the secrets of the planet LOEK III.
